main.description: One completed run of kinesin, recorded by the player after detaching. distance and steps are the run's final HUD numbers, denormalized so the network-wide /leaderboard replay doesn't need to re-simulate anything. Written and read by kinesin (https://kinesin.bisks.net).

distance.description: Distance walked along the microtubule before detaching, in nm (rounded).

steps.description: Number of ATP-powered steps (head-lock events) completed during the run.

walkedAt.description: When this run ended, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
